# Team Repository Good

A fixture team repository that passes `crystalline verify --team-repository`:
it carries the team marker, and Reflection is off, so `reflections/` is an
ordinary folder of engrams.

## Scope

- Facts about the harbor that a team shares

## When to Use

- When asked about the harbor's tides
